chunks: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of rising day
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often recited alongside Surah An-Nas as part of the 'Mu'awwidhatayn' (the two chapters of protection), emphasizing the necessity of seeking refuge in Allah's specific attributes to ward off both visible and hidden evils. The reference to 'Al-Falaq' (the Dawn) symbolizes the splitting open of darkness, serving as a metaphor for divine illumination overcoming the shadows of envy and malice.
